## 📜 Description

Refresh iOS caret geometry after the focused input changes layout so
`KeyboardAwareScrollView` follows the new line immediately. Deduplicate
identical selection events and reset the cache on blur.

## 💡 Motivation and Context

Addresses the growing-input case from #1129. With a controlled multiline
`TextInput`, Return can advance the selection index before RN resizes
the input. The event reports position `834` with the previous line's
`end.y=367.7`; the input then grows `379 → 400`, but KASV still uses
that old caret. The scroll stays at `33.7` until another character
produces fresh geometry.

The existing deferred layout observer now reads selection again after
updating the layout. This sends the corrected `834@388.7` and scrolls to
`54.7` without another keystroke. Comparing the complete
target/selection payload preserves that correction while suppressing
identical repeats; resetting the cache lets the same selection be
reported on refocus.

The same case also reproduces with #1734 (`b44ddfd`): its one-frame
delay can still run before the resize. A temporary 100 ms delay made the
repro pass, but still depended on RN's update timing. This change
follows the actual layout update and does not change the delay.

Reproduced before and after on `main` (`43032b5`), Fabric / RN 0.81.4:

1. Paste the snippet below into `FabricExample/index.js`.
2. Tap **Focus end**, type `12345678901234567`, then `8` and `9`. The
`8` wraps and scrolls correctly before and after the fix.
3. Press **Return**. Before: the field grows but the caret is hidden by
the keyboard. After: the caret stays visible immediately.
4. Type another character. Before: scrolling catches up only now. After:
there is no extra scroll.
5. Tap the title to dismiss the keyboard, then **Focus end** again. The
same caret position remains visible before and after.

<details>
<summary>Runnable reproduction — FabricExample/index.js, no additional
dependencies</summary>

```js
import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AppRegistry,
  Button,
  Keyboard,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import {
  KeyboardAwareScrollView,
  KeyboardProvider,
} from "react-native-keyboard-controller";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { name as appName } from "./app.json";

const INITIAL_TEXT =
  "The only way I could do that was if you wanted me too I could come and pick it out and then I can go pick up it from your place or you could just pick me out of there or you could come pick me out and I could just drop you back in my truck or you can come pick yo way to pick me out and I could coming to you or whatever I can do if that's easier or easier than it is to pick it out up from you or I could just pick you out or whatever I don't care but you know what you know what I just want you can do it and you know what you just have a little more money I just want you know what you need it just let it go to work on the car is it just let you can yes you can pick me out there I just want you can do whatever works out for me to do it I don't care if I don't want you can do what I don't want you can juice ";
const events = [];

global.__issue1129Minimal = { events };

function record(type, data) {
  events.push({ t: global.performance.now(), type, ...data });
}

function Repro() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(INITIAL_TEXT);
  const input = useRef(null);

  return (
    <View style={styles.root}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text
          accessibilityRole="button"
          style={styles.title}
          testID="issue1129-dismiss-keyboard"
          onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}
        >
          Issue 1129 — growing input
        </Text>
        <Button
          testID="issue1129-minimal-end"
          title="Focus end"
          onPress={() => {
            input.current?.focus();
            input.current?.setNativeProps({
              selection: { start: value.length, end: value.length },
            });
          }}
        />
        <Button
          testID="issue1129-minimal-reset"
          title="Reset"
          onPress={() => setValue(INITIAL_TEXT)}
        />
      </View>
      <KeyboardAwareScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
        scrollEventThrottle={16}
        testID="issue1129-minimal-scroll"
        onScroll={(e) => record("scroll", { y: e.nativeEvent.contentOffset.y })}
      >
        <View style={styles.spacer} />
        <TextInput
          ref={input}
          multiline
          accessibilityLabel="Issue 1129 growing input"
          scrollEnabled={false}
          style={styles.input}
          testID="issue1129-minimal-input"
          value={value}
          onChangeText={(text) => {
            record("text", { length: text.length, tail: text.slice(-30) });
            setValue(text);
          }}
          onLayout={(e) => record("layout", e.nativeEvent.layout)}
        />
      </KeyboardAwareScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <KeyboardProvider>
        <Repro />
      </KeyboardProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, paddingTop: 64, backgroundColor: "white" },
  header: { height: 97 },
  title: { fontSize: 18, textAlign: "center" },
  content: { padding: 16 },
  spacer: { height: 100 },
  input: {
    fontSize: 16,
    lineHeight: 21,
    color: "#111",
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: "#777",
    borderRadius: 8,
    padding: 10,
  },
});

AppRegistry.registerComponent(appName, () => App);
```

</details>

Fixes #1129

## 📢 Changelog

### iOS

- `FocusedInputObserver.swift`: refresh selection after layout changes,
skip identical selection payloads, and reuse
`noFocusedInputSelectionEvent` for initialization and blur cleanup.
- Read current caret geometry in `syncUpSelection()`, build the
selection payload in `onSelectionChange`, and deduplicate/dispatch it in
`dispatchSelectionEventToJS`.
- Run Swift Format and ObjC Lint on macOS 15 to avoid the macOS 14
runner retirement.

### Android

- Rename the layout dispatcher and cache to `dispatchLayoutEventToJS`
and `lastLayoutEventDispatched`, matching iOS.

## 🤔 How Has This Been Tested?

- iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.5/agent).
